verdict.rationale: Twenty's own docs say its AI agents can "enrich records with data from external sources." Its workflow docs list "auto-enrich new contacts with data from external APIs" as a use case, using record-change triggers with HTTP request or AI Agent steps. However, enrichment depends on the user wiring in external APIs; there is no built-in firmographic or contact data provider and no turnkey auto-enrichment of company records. Missing for 10: a native enrichment data source with firmographic and contact fields, automatic enrichment without user-built workflows, explicit company-record enrichment, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
